brief_summary:
The purpose of this study is to learn about the safety and effectiveness of berobenatide in adult women who have both stress urinary incontinence (SUI) and obesity or overweight.

Participants will be in the study for about 63 weeks
brief_title: The Purpose of This Study is to Learn About the Safety and Effectiveness of Berobenatide in Women With Urine Leakage and With Obesity or Overweight

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult women aged 18 years or older
* Body mass index (BMI) of 27 kg/m² or greater
* Have a diagnosis of stress urinary incontinence
* Willing and able to comply with study procedures

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have had urinary incontinence surgery
* Have taken medications (prescribed or over-the counter) intended to promote weight loss within 90 days prior to randomization
* Have recently received onabotulinumtoxin A (Botox) bladder injections or currently taking medications for urinary incontinence
* History of acute or chronic pancreatitis
* Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 (MEN-2)
* Have diabetes or laboratory assessments indicative of diabetes
* Have had a cardiovascular health condition within 90 days prior to randomization
* Are breastfeeding, pregnant, parturition in the past 12 months, planning to become pregnant in the following 12 months, or of childbearing potential and not using adequate contraception

official_title: A PHASE 3, RANDOMIZED, DOUBLE-BLIND, PLACEBO-CONTROLLED STUDY TO ASSESS THE EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF BEROBENATIDE IN ADULT FEMALE PARTICIPANTS WITH STRESS URINARY INCONTINENCE AND WITH OBESITY OR OVERWEIGHT (VESPER-SUI)

primary_outcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in Stress Incontinence Episode Frequency (IEF)
